chunks: And through his chain of narration, from Ali (peace be upon him), he said:
We are the People of the House; no one is comparable to us. The Qur'an was revealed in us, and we are the source (mine) of Prophethood.
ai.seo_question: What is the significance of the Ahl al-Bayt being described as the 'mine of Prophethood' in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: In this tradition from *Uyun Akhbar al-Rida*, Imam Ali (a.s.) establishes the ontological superiority of the Ahl al-Bayt, asserting that they are incomparable to any other group. He identifies them as the 'mine of Prophethood' (Ma'din al-Risalah), indicating that the essence and authority of the message originate from their spiritual lineage, while also affirming that specific Qur'anic verses were revealed directly concerning their unique status.

en.dr-ali-peiravi: 31-298 According to the same documentation, on the authority of Ali (a.s.), “
No one is comparable to us - the Members of the Holy Household - since the Qur’an has been revealed to us and the source of Prophethood is in our Household.”
